insights.data_profile: The dataset contains 164,808 records across 2 features (2 numerical, 0 categorical). The dataset is complete — no missing values detected. Outliers were detected in 1 column(s) using the IQR method — these were retained for training but may warrant domain investigation.
insights.task: No target column was specified. The system applies Unsupervised Learning — discovering natural groupings in the data without predefined labels. Useful for operational mode detection and anomaly profiling.
insights.model: After training and comparing all recommended models, KMeans achieved the best performance. It formed 3 coherent clusters with a Silhouette Score of 0.9460 (scores near +1 indicate well-separated, compact clusters).
